observations.behavior: Adds Redis-backed billing-period cache, its Redis client, and its use in billing checks; also adds cache-clearing and cache-failure fallbacks.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks cached row count for billing; if Redis fails, falls back to Postgres query. This could reduce billing-period staleness and avoid skipping billing checks on Redis blips.
